item.title: Tailwind CSS Installation Issues Vite React Project
item.description:
“Tailwind CSS Installation Issues Vite React Project”

Why is Tailwind CSS installation failing with Vite in my React project?

Several factors can lead to installation errors. The most prevalent issue stems from version mismatches, especially when transitioning or attempting to use a specific version of Tailwind CSS. Understanding the configuration differences between v3 and v4 is crucial.

Tailwind CSS Versioning and Configuration

Tailwind CSS v4 introduces significant changes, including the removal of tailwind.config.js in favor of a CSS-first configuration. While v4 is backward compatible with v3 setups, direct upgrades or mixed installations can cause conflicts.
